---
name: Checklist item proposal
about: Propose a new item for the checklist, or a change to one
title: '[CHECKLIST] '
labels: 'content'
assignees: ''
---

**Failure class**
The kind of failure this item catches (for example "database table readable without login").

**The check**
A plain-English check that someone can do without special tools.

**The fix**
A plain-English fix.

**Why it matters**
What goes wrong for the app owner or their users if it is missed.

**Sources**
Link a source for any statistic, standard or rule you mention. Do not name clients
or real incidents unless there is a public source.
